cards.title: max() and min()
cards.body: `max(nums)` gives the largest value in a list and `min(nums)` the smallest.

cards.title: len() counts items
cards.body: `len(nums)` tells you how many items a list has.

cards.title: Spot the bug
cards.body: It should print how many names are in the list, 3, but prints 4. Tap the bug.

bug.fix: `len(names[0])` counts the letters in the first name. Count the list itself: `len(names)`.

check.question: What does this print?
check.explanation: Among negative numbers, the one closest to zero is the largest.
